VARIADOR.NAME: 15HP Variable Frequency Drive
VARIADOR.DESCRIPTION: Three-phase speed controller ideal for industrial pumping systems.
VARIADOR.LONG_DESCRIPTION: This 15HP variable frequency drive provides exceptional torque control and energy efficiency for three-phase motors. It includes an intuitive control panel, overload and short-circuit protection, and easy integration through industrial communication protocols such as Modbus. Its robust enclosure makes it ideal for demanding field environments in the oil industry.

CABLE.NAME: Subaquatic Power Cable
CABLE.DESCRIPTION: 100m roll. Resistant to high pressure and corrosive environments.
CABLE.LONG_DESCRIPTION: 100-meter power cable roll designed specifically for deep immersion. Its reinforced polymer coating ensures zero leakage and extreme resistance to corrosive elements commonly found in wells. It supports high voltages without degradation of the transferred signal or power.
